SET LINESIZE 200
SET PAGESIZE 100
SET SERVEROUTPUT ON SIZE UNLIMITED

DROP TABLE Delivery_Request CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Rating CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Feedback CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Return_Request CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Payment CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Order_Detail CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Orders CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Inventory CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Reward_Redemption CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Member_Subscription CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Courier CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Employee CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Customer CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Item CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Supplier CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Delivery_Company CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Branch CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Reward CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;
DROP TABLE Member CASCADE CONSTRAINTS;

CREATE TABLE Member (
    member_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    age NUMBER(3) NOT NULL CHECK (age >= 12 AND age < 130),
    gender VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL CHECK (gender IN ('Male', 'Female')),
    phone_no VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR2(100) UNIQUE CHECK (email LIKE '%@%.%'),
    points_balance NUMBER(10) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL CHECK (points_balance >= 0),
    membership_type VARCHAR2(10) DEFAULT 'Normal' NOT NULL CHECK (membership_type IN ('Normal', 'VIP')),
    point_rate NUMBER(3,2) DEFAULT 1.00 NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR2(10) DEFAULT 'Active' NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('Active', 'Inactive')),
    PRIMARY KEY (member_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_member_rate CHECK ( (membership_type = 'Normal' AND point_rate = 1.00) OR (membership_type = 'VIP'    AND point_rate = 2.00) )
);

CREATE TABLE Reward (
    reward_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    quantity NUMBER(7) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL CHECK (quantity >= 0),
    points_required NUMBER(10) NOT NULL CHECK (points_required > 0),
    reward_type VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL CHECK (reward_type IN ('Discount', 'Free Delivery', 'Gift')),
    value NUMBER(7,2) DEFAULT 0.00 NOT NULL CHECK (value >= 0),
    status VARCHAR2(10) DEFAULT 'Active' NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('Active', 'Inactive')),
    PRIMARY KEY (reward_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Branch (
    branch_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    address VARCHAR2(255) NOT NULL,
    phone_no VARCHAR2(20),
    open_time VARCHAR2(10) DEFAULT '09:00',
    close_time VARCHAR2(10) DEFAULT '18:00',
    status VARCHAR2(10) DEFAULT 'Active' NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('Active', 'Inactive', 'Closed')),
    PRIMARY KEY (branch_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Delivery_Company (
    delivery_company_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    company_name VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    contact_no VARCHAR2(20),
    base_delivery_fee NUMBER(6,2) DEFAULT 0.00 NOT NULL CHECK (base_delivery_fee >= 0),
    status VARCHAR2(10) DEFAULT 'Active' NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('Active', 'Inactive')),
    PRIMARY KEY (delivery_company_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Supplier (
    supplier_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    company_name VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    contact_person VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    contact_no VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR2(100) UNIQUE CHECK (email LIKE '%@%.%'),
    address VARCHAR2(255),
    lead_time_days NUMBER(3) DEFAULT 3 NOT NULL CHECK (lead_time_days BETWEEN 1 AND 60),
    status VARCHAR2(10) DEFAULT 'Active' NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('Active', 'Inactive')),
    PRIMARY KEY (supplier_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Item (
    item_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    barcode VARCHAR2(50) UNIQUE,
    unit_price NUMBER(7,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price >= 0),
    unit_of_measure VARCHAR2(20) CHECK (unit_of_measure IN ('kg','g','L','ml','pcs','pack')),
    unit_weight_kg NUMBER(7,3) DEFAULT 0.000 NOT NULL CHECK (unit_weight_kg >= 0),
    category VARCHAR2(50) NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('Beverages', 'Canned and Preserved Food', 'Sauces', 'Snacks',  'Personal Care', 'Dairy and Eggs')),
    status VARCHAR2(10) DEFAULT 'Active' NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('Active', 'Inactive')),
    is_mykasih_eligible CHAR(1) DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL CHECK (is_mykasih_eligible IN ('Y', 'N')),
    supplier_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (item_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES Supplier(supplier_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Customer (
    customer_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    ic_number VARCHAR2(20) UNIQUE,
    member_id VARCHAR2(20),
    PRIMARY KEY (customer_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES Member(member_id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_customer_member UNIQUE (member_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Employee (
    employee_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    age NUMBER(3) NOT NULL CHECK (age >= 18 AND age < 70),
    contact_no VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    position VARCHAR2(50) CHECK (position IN ('Cashier','Manager','Supervisor','Stock Clerk')),
    salary NUMBER(8,2) CHECK (salary > 0),
    status VARCHAR2(10) DEFAULT 'Active' NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('Active', 'Inactive')),
    hire_date DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    branch_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (employee_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (branch_id) REFERENCES Branch(branch_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Courier (
    courier_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    contact_no VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    average_rating NUMBER(3,2) DEFAULT 0.00 CHECK (average_rating BETWEEN 0 AND 5.00),
    delivery_company_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (courier_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (delivery_company_id) REFERENCES Delivery_Company(delivery_company_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Member_Subscription (
    subscription_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    start_date DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    end_date DATE NOT NULL,
    fee_amount NUMBER(5,2) DEFAULT 12.00 NOT NULL CHECK (fee_amount = 12.00), 
    payment_status VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT 'Pending' NOT NULL CHECK (payment_status IN ('Pending', 'Paid', 'Cancelled', 'Expired')),
    member_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (subscription_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES Member(member_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_subscription_dates CHECK (end_date > start_date)
);

CREATE TABLE Reward_Redemption (
    redemption_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    quantity_redeemed NUMBER(5) NOT NULL CHECK (quantity_redeemed > 0),
    point_spent NUMBER(10) NOT NULL CHECK (point_spent > 0),
    issue_date DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    expiry_date DATE,
    status VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT 'Active' NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('Active', 'Used', 'Expired')),
    member_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    reward_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (redemption_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES Member(member_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (reward_id) REFERENCES Reward(reward_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_redemption_dates CHECK (expiry_date > issue_date) 
);

CREATE TABLE Inventory (
    branch_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    item_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    quantity NUMBER(8) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL CHECK (quantity >= 0),
    last_restock_date DATE,
    PRIMARY KEY (branch_id, item_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (branch_id) REFERENCES Branch(branch_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES Item(item_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Orders (
    order_no VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    order_date_time TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    order_type VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL CHECK (order_type IN ('Online', 'Walk-In')),
    service_type VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL CHECK (service_type IN ('Pickup', 'Delivery')),
    subtotal_amount NUMBER(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00 NOT NULL CHECK (subtotal_amount >= 0),
    total_amount NUMBER(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00 NOT NULL CHECK (total_amount >= 0),
    points_earned NUMBER(8) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL CHECK (points_earned >= 0),
    discount_amount NUMBER(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00 NOT NULL CHECK (discount_amount >= 0),
    order_status VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT 'Processing' NOT NULL CHECK (order_status IN ('Processing', 'Completed', 'Cancelled')),
    is_mykasih_purchase CHAR(1) DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL CHECK (is_mykasih_purchase IN ('Y', 'N')),
    redemption_id VARCHAR2(20) UNIQUE,
    customer_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    branch_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    handled_by VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (order_no),
    FOREIGN KEY (redemption_id) REFERENCES reward_redemption (redemption_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES Customer(customer_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (branch_id) REFERENCES Branch(branch_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (handled_by) REFERENCES Employee(employee_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_orders_discount CHECK (discount_amount <= subtotal_amount),
    CONSTRAINT chk_orders_total CHECK (
        (service_type = 'Pickup'   AND total_amount =  subtotal_amount - discount_amount) OR
        (service_type = 'Delivery' AND total_amount >= subtotal_amount - discount_amount)),
    CONSTRAINT chk_walk_delivery CHECK (NOT (order_type = 'Walk-In' AND service_type = 'Delivery'))
);

CREATE TABLE Order_Detail (
    order_no VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    item_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    subtotal NUMBER(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (subtotal >= 0),
    quantity NUMBER(5) NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
    unit_price NUMBER(7,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price >= 0),
    PRIMARY KEY (order_no, item_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (order_no) REFERENCES Orders(order_no),
    FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES Item(item_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_od_subtotal CHECK (subtotal = quantity * unit_price)
);

CREATE TABLE Payment (
    payment_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    payment_method VARCHAR2(50) NOT NULL CHECK (payment_method IN ('Cash','Card','E-Wallet','MyKasih','Online Banking')),
    payment_date_time TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    reference_no VARCHAR2(100) UNIQUE,
    payment_status VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT 'Pending' NOT NULL CHECK (payment_status IN ('Pending', 'Paid', 'Failed', 'Cancelled', 'Refunded')),
    order_no VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    PRIMARY KEY (payment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (order_no) REFERENCES Orders(order_no)
);

CREATE TABLE Return_Request (
    return_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    reason VARCHAR2(60) NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN (
        'Changed mind after purchase',
        'Wrong item delivered',
        'Quantity short delivered',
        'Damaged packaging',
        'Item defective',
        'Item expired',
        'Received near expiry stock',
        'Seal was broken',
        'Product leaking')),
    request_date DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT 'Requested' NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('Requested', 'Approved', 'Rejected', 'Refunded')),
    refund_amount NUMBER(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00 CHECK (refund_amount >= 0),
    remarks VARCHAR2(500),
    return_quantity NUMBER(5) NOT NULL CHECK (return_quantity > 0),
    order_no VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    item_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    reviewed_by VARCHAR2(20),
    PRIMARY KEY (return_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_return_orderdetail FOREIGN KEY (order_no, item_id) REFERENCES Order_Detail(order_no, item_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (reviewed_by) REFERENCES Employee(employee_id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_return_orderdetail UNIQUE (order_no, item_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Feedback (
    feedback_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    description VARCHAR2(1000) NOT NULL,
    feedback_date DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    order_no VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    PRIMARY KEY (feedback_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (order_no) REFERENCES Orders(order_no)
);

CREATE TABLE Rating (
    rating_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    score NUMBER(1) NOT NULL CHECK (score BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    comments VARCHAR2(500),
    rating_date DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE NOT NULL,
    order_no VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    item_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (rating_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_rating_orderdetail FOREIGN KEY (order_no, item_id) REFERENCES Order_Detail(order_no, item_id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_rating_orderdetail UNIQUE (order_no, item_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Delivery_Request (
    delivery_request_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    recipient_name VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    recipient_phone_no VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    delivery_address VARCHAR2(255) NOT NULL,
    delivery_fee NUMBER(6,2) DEFAULT 0.00 NOT NULL CHECK (delivery_fee >= 0),
    delivered_date_time TIMESTAMP,
    status VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT 'Processing' NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('Processing', 'Delivered', 'Failed')),
    rating NUMBER(1) CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    order_no VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    courier_id VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (delivery_request_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (order_no) REFERENCES Orders(order_no),
    FOREIGN KEY (courier_id) REFERENCES Courier(courier_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_dr_delivered CHECK (status <> 'Delivered' OR delivered_date_time IS NOT NULL),
    CONSTRAINT chk_dr_rating    CHECK (rating IS NULL OR status = 'Delivered')
);

-- TRIGGERS
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_delivery_fee
BEFORE INSERT ON Delivery_Request
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
    v_service Orders.service_type%TYPE;
    v_base    Delivery_Company.base_delivery_fee%TYPE;
    v_weight  NUMBER;
BEGIN
    SELECT service_type INTO v_service FROM Orders WHERE order_no = :NEW.order_no;
    IF v_service <> 'Delivery' THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20103,
            'Order ' || :NEW.order_no || ' is a pickup order and cannot be delivered.');
    END IF;

    IF :NEW.delivery_fee IS NULL THEN
        SELECT dc.base_delivery_fee INTO v_base
        FROM   Courier c JOIN Delivery_Company dc
               ON dc.delivery_company_id = c.delivery_company_id
        WHERE  c.courier_id = :NEW.courier_id;

        SELECT NVL(SUM(i.unit_weight_kg * od.quantity), 0) INTO v_weight
        FROM   Order_Detail od JOIN Item i ON i.item_id = od.item_id
        WHERE  od.order_no = :NEW.order_no;

        :NEW.delivery_fee := ROUND(v_base + v_weight, 2);
    END IF;
END;
/


CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_order_business_hours
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF order_date_time ON Orders
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
    v_hour NUMBER;
BEGIN
    IF :NEW.order_date_time IS NULL THEN
        :NEW.order_date_time := SYSTIMESTAMP;
    END IF;
    v_hour := TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(:NEW.order_date_time, 'HH24'));
    IF v_hour < 9 OR v_hour >= 22 THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20120,
            'Order time ' || TO_CHAR(:NEW.order_date_time, 'HH24:MI') ||
            ' is outside trading hours. Branches trade from 09:00 to 22:00.');
    END IF;
END;
/



CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_payment_time
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF payment_date_time ON Payment
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
    v_hour    NUMBER;
    v_order   Orders.order_date_time%TYPE;
    v_minutes NUMBER;
BEGIN
    IF :NEW.payment_date_time IS NULL THEN
        :NEW.payment_date_time := SYSTIMESTAMP;
    END IF;

    v_hour := TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(:NEW.payment_date_time, 'HH24'));
    IF v_hour < 9 OR v_hour >= 22 THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20103,
            'Payment time ' || TO_CHAR(:NEW.payment_date_time, 'HH24:MI') ||
            ' is outside trading hours. Branches trade from 09:00 to 22:00.');
    END IF;

    SELECT order_date_time INTO v_order FROM Orders WHERE order_no = :NEW.order_no;

    IF :NEW.payment_date_time < v_order THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20104,
            'A payment cannot be dated before the order it settles.');
    END IF;

    v_minutes := (CAST(:NEW.payment_date_time AS DATE) - CAST(v_order AS DATE)) * 1440;
    IF v_minutes > 15 THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20105,
            'Order ' || :NEW.order_no || ' must be paid within 15 minutes of being created. ' ||
            'This payment is ' || ROUND(v_minutes) || ' minutes after the order.');
    END IF;
END;
/




CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_delivery_time
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF delivered_date_time ON Delivery_Request
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
    v_hour    NUMBER;
    v_order   Orders.order_date_time%TYPE;
    v_minutes NUMBER;
BEGIN
    IF :NEW.delivered_date_time IS NULL THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    v_hour := TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(:NEW.delivered_date_time, 'HH24'));
    IF v_hour < 9 OR v_hour >= 22 THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20106,
            'Delivery time ' || TO_CHAR(:NEW.delivered_date_time, 'HH24:MI') ||
            ' is outside trading hours. Deliveries run from 09:00 to 22:00.');
    END IF;

    SELECT order_date_time INTO v_order FROM Orders WHERE order_no = :NEW.order_no;

    IF :NEW.delivered_date_time < v_order THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20107,
            'A delivery cannot be dated before the order was placed.');
    END IF;

    v_minutes := (CAST(:NEW.delivered_date_time AS DATE) - CAST(v_order AS DATE)) * 1440;
    IF v_minutes > 120 THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20108,
            'Order ' || :NEW.order_no || ' must be delivered within 2 hours. This delivery is ' ||
            ROUND(v_minutes) || ' minutes after the order.');
    END IF;
END;
/



CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_deduct_stock
AFTER INSERT ON Order_Detail
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
    v_branch Orders.branch_id%TYPE;
    v_status Orders.order_status%TYPE;
    v_onhand Inventory.quantity%TYPE;
    v_name   Item.name%TYPE;
BEGIN
    SELECT branch_id, order_status INTO v_branch, v_status
    FROM   Orders WHERE order_no = :NEW.order_no;

    IF v_status = 'Cancelled' THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    BEGIN
        SELECT inv.quantity, i.name INTO v_onhand, v_name
        FROM   Inventory inv JOIN Item i ON i.item_id = inv.item_id
        WHERE  inv.branch_id = v_branch AND inv.item_id = :NEW.item_id
        FOR UPDATE OF inv.quantity;
    EXCEPTION
        WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20101,
                'Item ' || :NEW.item_id || ' is not stocked at branch ' || v_branch || '.');
    END;

    IF v_onhand < :NEW.quantity THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20102,
            'Not enough stock of ' || v_name || ' at branch ' || v_branch ||
            '. On hand ' || v_onhand || ', ordered ' || :NEW.quantity || '.');
    END IF;

    UPDATE Inventory SET quantity = quantity - :NEW.quantity
    WHERE  branch_id = v_branch AND item_id = :NEW.item_id;
END;
/




CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_order_amounts
AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON Order_Detail
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
    v_delta NUMBER := 0;
    v_order Orders.order_no%TYPE;
BEGIN
    IF INSERTING THEN
        v_delta := :NEW.subtotal;                  v_order := :NEW.order_no;
    ELSIF UPDATING THEN
        v_delta := :NEW.subtotal - :OLD.subtotal;  v_order := :NEW.order_no;
    ELSE
        v_delta := -:OLD.subtotal;                 v_order := :OLD.order_no;
    END IF;

    UPDATE Orders
    SET    subtotal_amount = subtotal_amount + v_delta,
           total_amount    = total_amount    + v_delta
    WHERE  order_no = v_order;
END;
/



CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_delivery_fee_to_order
AFTER INSERT ON Delivery_Request
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    UPDATE Orders SET total_amount = total_amount + :NEW.delivery_fee
    WHERE  order_no = :NEW.order_no;
END;
/



CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_payment_completes_order
AFTER UPDATE OF payment_status ON Payment
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN (NEW.payment_status = 'Paid' AND OLD.payment_status <> 'Paid')
BEGIN
    UPDATE Orders SET order_status = 'Completed'
    WHERE  order_no = :NEW.order_no AND order_status = 'Processing';
END;
/



CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_award_points
BEFORE UPDATE OF order_status ON Orders
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN (NEW.order_status = 'Completed' AND OLD.order_status <> 'Completed')
DECLARE
    v_member Member.member_id%TYPE;
    v_rate   Member.point_rate%TYPE;
    v_points NUMBER;
BEGIN
    SELECT member_id INTO v_member FROM Customer WHERE customer_id = :NEW.customer_id;
    IF v_member IS NULL THEN
        :NEW.points_earned := 0;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    SELECT point_rate INTO v_rate FROM Member WHERE member_id = v_member;
    v_points := FLOOR(:NEW.subtotal_amount - :NEW.discount_amount) * v_rate;
    :NEW.points_earned := v_points;

    UPDATE Member SET points_balance = points_balance + v_points
    WHERE  member_id = v_member;
END;
/




CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_cancel_order
AFTER UPDATE OF order_status ON Orders
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN (NEW.order_status = 'Cancelled' AND OLD.order_status <> 'Cancelled')
DECLARE
    v_member Member.member_id%TYPE;
BEGIN
    FOR line IN (SELECT item_id, quantity FROM Order_Detail WHERE order_no = :NEW.order_no) LOOP
        UPDATE Inventory SET quantity = quantity + line.quantity
        WHERE  branch_id = :NEW.branch_id AND item_id = line.item_id;
    END LOOP;

    IF :OLD.points_earned > 0 THEN
        SELECT member_id INTO v_member FROM Customer WHERE customer_id = :NEW.customer_id;
        IF v_member IS NOT NULL THEN
            UPDATE Member
            SET    points_balance = GREATEST(points_balance - :OLD.points_earned, 0)
            WHERE  member_id = v_member;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    UPDATE Payment SET payment_status = 'Cancelled'
    WHERE  order_no = :NEW.order_no AND payment_status IN ('Pending', 'Failed');
END;
/



CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_redeem_reward
BEFORE INSERT ON Reward_Redemption
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
    v_required Reward.points_required%TYPE;
    v_stock    Reward.quantity%TYPE;
    v_status   Reward.status%TYPE;
    v_balance  Member.points_balance%TYPE;
    v_mstatus  Member.status%TYPE;
    v_cost     NUMBER;
BEGIN
    SELECT points_balance, status INTO v_balance, v_mstatus
    FROM   Member WHERE member_id = :NEW.member_id FOR UPDATE;

    IF v_mstatus <> 'Active' THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20111,
            'Member ' || :NEW.member_id || ' is not active and cannot redeem a reward.');
    END IF;

    SELECT points_required, quantity, status INTO v_required, v_stock, v_status
    FROM   Reward WHERE reward_id = :NEW.reward_id FOR UPDATE;

    IF v_status <> 'Active' THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20104, 'Reward ' || :NEW.reward_id || ' is no longer offered.');
    END IF;
    IF v_stock < :NEW.quantity_redeemed THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20105,
            'Reward ' || :NEW.reward_id || ' is out of stock. ' || v_stock || ' left.');
    END IF;

    v_cost := v_required * :NEW.quantity_redeemed;
    IF :NEW.point_spent IS NULL OR :NEW.point_spent = 0 THEN
        :NEW.point_spent := v_cost;
    END IF;
    IF :NEW.expiry_date IS NULL THEN
        :NEW.expiry_date := ADD_MONTHS(NVL(:NEW.issue_date, SYSDATE), 12);
    END IF;

    IF v_balance < v_cost THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20106,
            'Member ' || :NEW.member_id || ' has ' || v_balance ||
            ' points but the reward costs ' || v_cost || '.');
    END IF;

    UPDATE Member SET points_balance = points_balance - v_cost
    WHERE  member_id = :NEW.member_id;
    UPDATE Reward SET quantity = quantity - :NEW.quantity_redeemed
    WHERE  reward_id = :NEW.reward_id;
END;
/



CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_subscription_vip
AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF payment_status, end_date ON Member_Subscription
BEGIN
    UPDATE Member m
    SET    m.membership_type =
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Member_Subscription s
                             WHERE s.member_id = m.member_id
                             AND   s.payment_status = 'Paid'
                             AND   s.end_date > SYSDATE)
                THEN 'VIP' ELSE 'Normal' END,
           m.point_rate =
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Member_Subscription s
                             WHERE s.member_id = m.member_id
                             AND   s.payment_status = 'Paid'
                             AND   s.end_date > SYSDATE)
                THEN 2.00 ELSE 1.00 END
    WHERE  m.membership_type <>
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Member_Subscription s
                             WHERE s.member_id = m.member_id
                             AND   s.payment_status = 'Paid'
                             AND   s.end_date > SYSDATE)
                THEN 'VIP' ELSE 'Normal' END;
END;
/



CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_validate_return
BEFORE INSERT ON Return_Request
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
    v_qty     Order_Detail.quantity%TYPE;
    v_line    Order_Detail.subtotal%TYPE;
    v_ordered Orders.order_date_time%TYPE;
    v_status  Orders.order_status%TYPE;
BEGIN
    SELECT od.quantity, od.subtotal, o.order_date_time, o.order_status
    INTO   v_qty, v_line, v_ordered, v_status
    FROM   Order_Detail od JOIN Orders o ON o.order_no = od.order_no
    WHERE  od.order_no = :NEW.order_no AND od.item_id = :NEW.item_id;

    IF v_status <> 'Completed' THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20107,
            'Only a completed order can be returned. Order ' || :NEW.order_no ||
            ' is ' || v_status || '.');
    END IF;
    IF NVL(:NEW.request_date, SYSDATE) > CAST(v_ordered AS DATE) + 7 THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20108,
            'The seven day return period for order ' || :NEW.order_no || ' has passed.');
    END IF;
    IF :NEW.return_quantity > v_qty THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20109,
            'Only ' || v_qty || ' unit(s) of item ' || :NEW.item_id ||
            ' were bought on order ' || :NEW.order_no || '.');
    END IF;
    IF NVL(:NEW.refund_amount, 0) > v_line THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20110,
            'The refund cannot be more than the RM' || v_line || ' paid for the line.');
    END IF;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20112,
            'Item ' || :NEW.item_id || ' does not appear on order ' || :NEW.order_no || '.');
END;
/




CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_refund_restores_stock
AFTER UPDATE OF payment_status ON Payment
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN (NEW.payment_status = 'Refunded' AND OLD.payment_status <> 'Refunded')
DECLARE
    v_branch Orders.branch_id%TYPE;
    v_lines  NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
    SELECT branch_id INTO v_branch FROM Orders WHERE order_no = :NEW.order_no;

    FOR r IN (SELECT rr.item_id, rr.return_quantity, rr.reason, i.name AS item_name
              FROM   Return_Request rr JOIN Item i ON i.item_id = rr.item_id
              WHERE  rr.order_no = :NEW.order_no
              AND    rr.status = 'Refunded') LOOP
        v_lines := v_lines + 1;

        IF r.reason IN ('Changed mind after purchase', 'Wrong item delivered') THEN
            UPDATE Inventory SET quantity = quantity + r.return_quantity
            WHERE  branch_id = v_branch AND item_id = r.item_id;
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('BACK ON SHELF : ' || r.return_quantity || ' x ' ||
                                 r.item_name || ' at branch ' || v_branch ||
                                 ' (' || r.reason || ').');

        ELSIF r.reason = 'Quantity short delivered' THEN
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('SHORT DELIVERY : ' || r.return_quantity || ' x ' ||
                                 r.item_name || ' never reached the customer and never ' ||
                                 'came back. Stock at branch ' || v_branch || ' unchanged.');

        ELSE
            DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('WRITTEN OFF : ' || r.return_quantity || ' x ' ||
                                 r.item_name || ' at branch ' || v_branch ||
                                 ' (' || r.reason || '). Not fit to sell again.');
        END IF;
    END LOOP;

    -- a refund with no return behind it means the whole order came back
    IF v_lines = 0 THEN
        FOR line IN (SELECT item_id, quantity FROM Order_Detail
                     WHERE order_no = :NEW.order_no) LOOP
            UPDATE Inventory SET quantity = quantity + line.quantity
            WHERE  branch_id = v_branch AND item_id = line.item_id;
        END LOOP;
    END IF;
END;
/




CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_courier_average_rating
FOR INSERT OR UPDATE OF rating ON Delivery_Request
COMPOUND TRIGGER

    TYPE t_courier_list IS TABLE OF Courier.courier_id%TYPE INDEX BY VARCHAR2(20);
    g_touched t_courier_list;

    AFTER EACH ROW IS
    BEGIN
        IF :NEW.rating IS NOT NULL THEN
            g_touched(:NEW.courier_id) := :NEW.courier_id;
        END IF;
    END AFTER EACH ROW;

    AFTER STATEMENT IS
        v_id VARCHAR2(20);
    BEGIN
        v_id := g_touched.FIRST;
        WHILE v_id IS NOT NULL LOOP
            UPDATE Courier c
            SET    c.average_rating = NVL((SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.rating), 2)
                                           FROM   Delivery_Request d
                                           WHERE  d.courier_id = c.courier_id
                                           AND    d.rating IS NOT NULL), c.average_rating)
            WHERE  c.courier_id = v_id;
            v_id := g_touched.NEXT(v_id);
        END LOOP;
        g_touched.DELETE;
    END AFTER STATEMENT;

END trg_courier_average_rating;
/




CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_low_stock_alert
AFTER UPDATE OF quantity ON Inventory
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN (NEW.quantity < 20 AND NEW.quantity < OLD.quantity)
DECLARE
    v_item     Item.name%TYPE;
    v_supplier Supplier.company_name%TYPE;
    v_lead     Supplier.lead_time_days%TYPE;
BEGIN
    SELECT i.name, s.company_name, s.lead_time_days
    INTO   v_item, v_supplier, v_lead
    FROM   Item i JOIN Supplier s ON s.supplier_id = i.supplier_id
    WHERE  i.item_id = :NEW.item_id;

    IF :NEW.quantity = 0 THEN
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('OUT OF STOCK : ' || v_item || ' at branch ' ||
                             :NEW.branch_id || '. Reorder from ' || v_supplier ||
                             ', lead time ' || v_lead || ' day(s).');
    ELSE
        DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('LOW STOCK : ' || v_item || ' at branch ' || :NEW.branch_id ||
                             ' is down to ' || :NEW.quantity || ' unit(s). Reorder from ' ||
                             v_supplier || ', lead time ' || v_lead || ' day(s).');
    END IF;
END;
/



CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_protect_completed_order
BEFORE DELETE ON Orders
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN (OLD.order_status = 'Completed')
BEGIN
    RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20111,
        'Order ' || :OLD.order_no || ' is completed and cannot be deleted.');
END;
/




CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_item_supplier_active
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF supplier_id, status ON Item
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
    v_status Supplier.status%TYPE;
    v_name   Supplier.company_name%TYPE;
BEGIN
    IF :NEW.status <> 'Active' THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    SELECT status, company_name INTO v_status, v_name
    FROM   Supplier WHERE supplier_id = :NEW.supplier_id;

    IF v_status <> 'Active' THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20121,
            'Item ' || :NEW.item_id || ' cannot be sold because supplier ' || v_name ||
            ' is no longer trading with us.');
    END IF;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20122,
            'Supplier ' || :NEW.supplier_id || ' does not exist.');
END;
/



CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_supplier_status_guard
BEFORE UPDATE OF status OR DELETE ON Supplier
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
    v_active NUMBER;
    v_any    NUMBER;
BEGIN
    IF DELETING THEN
        SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_any FROM Item WHERE supplier_id = :OLD.supplier_id;
        IF v_any > 0 THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20123,
                'Supplier ' || :OLD.company_name || ' still supplies ' || v_any ||
                ' product(s) and cannot be deleted.');
        END IF;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    IF :NEW.status = 'Inactive' AND :OLD.status = 'Active' THEN
        SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_active FROM Item
        WHERE  supplier_id = :OLD.supplier_id AND status = 'Active';
        IF v_active > 0 THEN
            RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20124,
                'Supplier ' || :OLD.company_name || ' still supplies ' || v_active ||
                ' product(s) that are on sale. Discontinue them first.');
        END IF;
    END IF;
END;
/



CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_order_handler_valid
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF handled_by, branch_id ON Orders
FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
    v_branch   Employee.branch_id%TYPE;
    v_position Employee.position%TYPE;
    v_status   Employee.status%TYPE;
    v_name     Employee.name%TYPE;
BEGIN
    SELECT branch_id, position, status, name
    INTO   v_branch, v_position, v_status, v_name
    FROM   Employee WHERE employee_id = :NEW.handled_by;

    IF v_branch <> :NEW.branch_id THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20125,
            v_name || ' works at branch ' || v_branch ||
            ' and cannot serve an order made at branch ' || :NEW.branch_id || '.');
    END IF;

    IF v_position NOT IN ('Cashier', 'Supervisor', 'Manager') THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20126,
            v_name || ' is a ' || v_position || ' and does not serve at the counter.');
    END IF;

    IF INSERTING AND v_status <> 'Active' THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20127,
            v_name || ' has left the company and cannot be recorded on a new order.');
    END IF;
EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
        RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20128,
            'Employee ' || :NEW.handled_by || ' does not exist.');
END;
/
